panels.description: Alex presses his scarred palm to a wet riveted pipe while Bi11bot compares an adjacent dry line. Reserve upper-right for Alex’s balloon and lower-right for Bi11bot’s reply, with separate vertical zones; keep the lower-left pipe area clear for the vibration SFX.

Old gauges and manual wheels fill the regulator gallery. A clean cable and control line graft into a compact white-and-amber node, with matching cable architecture continuing toward the basin infrastructure spine. Reserve the upper band.
Alex follows the clean line into the newer housing bolted over an old valve plate while Bi11bot leans close. Reserve upper-left, upper-right, and lower-right.
Alex scrapes mineral crust away, revealing repeating loops around the node. His watch hangs beside the etched pattern. Keep the pattern and watch unobstructed; reserve upper-left for SFX.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Someone fed a new control into an old regulator.
